item.title: Watch: 2 Congress leaders slap each other during ‘vote theft’ protest in Faridabad
item.description: Tensions flared during a Faridabad protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, resulting in Congress leaders Parag Sharma and Gajna Lamba clashing. The confrontation began when Sharma was seen slapping Lamba, which sparked immediate retaliation. Baljit Kaushik, the Congress District president, was among those who tried to intervene. A complaint was said to be filed at the Faridabad Old Police Station, but police have not verified this information.
item.dc:creator: SHREEDHAR RATHI

item.title: Why has New Zealand's T20I squad changed ahead of the India series?
item.description: New Zealand have made two changes to their T20I squad for the upcoming five-match series against India after Mark Chapman and Zak Foulkes were ruled out with injuries. Allrounder Josh Clarkson and fast bowler Blair Tickner have been called up to replace the injured players. The series is scheduled to begin on October 22.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: Musk shares 'congratulations message' to fellow recipients as US govt presents medals
item.description: At the Science: A New Golden Age Summit, the US government honored tech visionaries such as Jensen Huang and Lisa Su with the National Medal of Science. President Donald Trump awarded these distinguished medals, recognizing their exceptional impact on technology and innovation, showcasing the profound influence these leaders have on the fabric of American society and its economy.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: ‘The Orange Plague’: Why a golden, naked Trump is sitting on another man
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: Rs 2 cr deposit, no ITR, Rs 2.51 cr addition; ITAT quashes case due to 5 day delay
item.description: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT), Chennai, has quashed a reassessment involving Rs 2.51 crore additionals after holding that the Income Tax Department had issued the reopening notice after the statutory time limit had already expired.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: Can a warship become a mini aircraft carrier? India, US are testing two different answers
item.description: India is advancing its Naval Shipborne Unmanned Aerial System programme after receiving clearance from the Defence Acquisition Council. The systems will enhance intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance for naval operations and support various missions. The Indian drones aim for at least 60% indigenous content and face operational challenges from the maritime environment. Meanwhile, the United States is developing advanced AI-piloted drones for naval warfare without requiring a runway.
item.dc:creator: DHRUV YADAV

item.title: Kerala HC orders FIR against former CM Vijayan in CMRL bribery case
item.dc:creator: ABHISHEK MISHRA

item.title: 21-year-old raises over $146,000 for 80-year-old AMC usher in under 24 hours
item.description: A 21-year-old woman in Tennessee raised more than $146,000 in less than 24 hours for an 80-year-old AMC cinema worker after noticing her cleaning up rubbish. Brooklyn Green initially hoped to collect $500 through TikTok and GoFundMe. The elderly worker, Mary, who has worked in theatres for over 45 years, later thanked donors and requested that the fundraiser be paused.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Why children ask you to repeat silly words again and again, says psychology
item.description: The joy of silly words captivates children as they anticipate the playful sounds, fostering laughter and social interaction. While adults might not share this enthusiasm for long, children revel in these exchanges that nurture vital communication skills. Through these interactions, they not only express preferences but also enhance their vocabulary, paving the way for meaningful language development during these formative years.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Jeff Bezos to Americans: Stop 'hating' AI, it may make '3-day work week' possible
item.description: Jeff Bezos believes that advancements in AI could enable families to support themselves by working less. He suggests that one partner in dual-income families may choose to stop working if not needed financially. Bezos also attributes recent job cuts at Amazon to rapid hiring during the Covid-19 pandemic, rather than to AI. He acknowledges the existence of an AI bubble but emphasizes that the technology itself remains valuable.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Arkansas family wins $12,000 after neighbours removed old fence and trees
item.description: A recent ruling upheld the Bowlin family's claim regarding a fence that served as a property boundary since 1967. This decision followed a dispute over the removal of the fence and trees by neighboring property owners. The Arkansas Court of Appeals affirmed damages of $12,000 due to intentional tree removal and ordered the reconstruction of the fence.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: ‘It cannot happen’: Ex-India cricketer rules out Sooryavanshi replacing Samson
item.description: After lackluster performances in the T20I series against the West Indies, Sanju Samson is under fire from critics. Aakash Chopra advises against dropping him for Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, asserting that Samson's previous accomplishments merit further chances. Meanwhile, Nitish Kumar Reddy's entry into the squad is debated but seems unlikely imminently. The talks surrounding India's opening combination will likely persist as long as performance concerns remain.
item.dc:creator: PRANAV SHUKLA

item.title: IT firms including TCS, Infosys suspended from US green card: How it hits Indians
item.description: The list of companies which have been suspended by the Trump administration from the Permanent Labour Certification Programme (PERM) includes IT sector majors like TCS, Infosys, Microsoft, Wipro, and Cognizant. By suspending major IT companies from the PERM programme, the US government is effectively putting another barrier in front of thousands of Indian professionals.
item.dc:creator: SMRITI JAIN

item.title: Ohio man faces eviction from $4.5m mansion after 15-year foreclosure fight
item.description: In an ongoing foreclosure saga in Aurora, Ohio, Louis Telerico faces eviction after a lengthy battle. The mansion was sold to ERADAL in July 2026, yet Telerico continues to occupy the home, seeking a deal to buy it back. As ERADAL evaluates the property for restoration amid legal challenges, doubts linger over Telerico's financing options to reclaim his estate.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Donald Bren helped protect 57,500 acres of California’s historic Irvine Ranch
item.description: Billionaire real-estate developer Donald Bren transformed a significant part of the historic Irvine Ranch into protected public lands. After becoming chairman of the Irvine Company, he spearheaded major conservation milestones over the years. The Irvine Ranch now has over 57,000 acres preserved, providing habitats for diverse wildlife. In 2005, the Irvine Ranch Conservancy was established to ensure the ongoing care of these protected areas.
item.dc:creator: TOI SCIENCE DESK

item.title: Starlink entry row: Is Ambani the real boss of India, asks Elon Musk
item.description: Elon Musk has raised concerns about regulatory obstacles facing Starlink's introduction in India. He claimed influential figures might be hindering the process and questioned if Ambani controls the situation. In response, India's government reaffirmed its fair and non-discriminatory approach, rejecting Musk's allegations. Other companies like Reliance Jio and Eutelsat OneWeb are also vying for approval to offer satellite services.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH SINHA

item.title: 'Our cameras will be sharp': Broadcaster takes a dig at Australia over Sandpapergate
item.description: South African sports broadcaster SuperSport has taken a dig at Australia ahead of their first Test series in South Africa since the 2018 ball-tampering scandal, also known as Sandpapergate. Australia will face South Africa in a three-match series, with the opening Test scheduled at Kingsmead in Durban on Friday, October 9, at 1 pm IST.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: CJP alleges Rajasthan police drove Deepak Baliyan 100km before releasing him
item.dc:creator: AADRITA HALDER

item.title: Exclusive | Pranavi on golf's 'rich man's sport' tag: 'In reality, it really isn't'
item.description: Pranavi Urs, 1st Indian woman to win an individual Asian Games golf gold, wants to bring more attention to a sport she believes is still misunderstood in India. From the rise of women's golf, influence of Aditi Ashok to the support system behind her career, Pranavi speaks on what the medal can do for the sport, overcoming a final-round setback and her belief that an LET title will eventually come.
item.dc:creator: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN

item.title: TN villagers say they were forced to fall at feet of dominant caste
item.description: The community of Perumpalli witnessed blatant discrimination against Dalits seeking to bury their deceased, Senni, in a shared burial ground. As the family attempted to claim the space, Rithuvarman and other non-Dalits impeded their efforts. In a striking moment, two Dalits resorted to begging on their knees for permission. Ultimately, police presence facilitated the burial, preventing further conflict and allowing the family to grieve.
item.dc:creator: SENTHIL KUMARAN

item.title: 'Drunk men around me': Assam student's last video from train before she went missing
item.description: Himashri Boro, a 20-year-old student from Assam, was travelling alone after a dance competition. She felt unsafe in her train compartment due to inebriated men surrounding her and reached out to her family. Contact was lost between 2:30am and 3:00am, prompting her family to alert the railway authorities. Her body was later discovered near railway tracks in Andhra Pradesh’s Srikakulam district.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: 'This is emergency': 10,000 detained ahead of Delhi's Jantar Mantar stir, says CJP
item.description: The Cockroach Janta Party's planned protest in Delhi has faced significant opposition, leading to numerous detentions across the country. Over 10,000 individuals, including students, were detained ahead of the October 10 demonstration. CJP leaders have criticized the government's restrictions on public gatherings while demanding accountability for alleged electoral irregularities. As civil society groups rally in support, the party persists in organizing the protest.
item.dc:creator: HADI KHAN

item.title: Dr Phil’s Beverly Hills mansion bought for $29.8m now lists for $67.5m
item.description: Dr. Phil and his wife Robin McGraw are parting ways with their opulent Beverly Hills estate, listed for a staggering $67.5 million. Acquired for $29.8 million in 2010, the couple undertook extensive renovations, culminating in a dream home featuring eight luxurious bedrooms, a swimming pool, and a guesthouse. This significant increase in value mirrors the thriving real estate market trends in the prestigious Beverly Hills neighborhood.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Sandra Bullock’s 91-acre California ranch with 1,200 avocado trees sells for $5.6M
item.description: In 2007, Sandra Bullock acquired a sprawling 91-acre ranch in Valley Center for $2.725 million. After transforming it with extensive renovations and establishing an organic avocado farm, she sold the property for $5.6 million in 2024. Encompassing a beautifully refurbished adobe house, a guest cottage, and facilities for agricultural operations, the ranch stands as a perfect blend of luxury and sustainability for its future owner.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Rs 1,500 to Rs 18 crore: The rise of Gond artist Jangarh Singh Shyam
item.description: In September 2026, a remarkable auction saw Jangarh Singh Shyam's art reach the astonishing price of ₹18 crore, reigniting public fascination with his work. Hailing from Madhya Pradesh, Shyam pioneered a unique art form known as Jangarh Kalam, celebrating Gond cultural traditions. Despite experiencing struggles as an indigenous artist, he achieved global recognition before his tragic death by suicide in 2001 in Japan.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: TCS says Trump's PERM suspension won't affect US plans, targets 15,000 new hires
item.description: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) stated that the US government's suspension of the PERM programme would not affect its workforce strategy. The company emphasized its commitment to hiring local talent across its numerous offices in the US. TCS plans to increase its workforce in the US by hiring 15,000 employees over the next five years. The US government suspended the PERM programme as part of a crackdown on skilled-worker immigration.
item.dc:creator: KANCHAN YADAV

item.title: India's GDP is booming, but stock market is crashing: What's going wrong?
item.description: India is experiencing impressive GDP growth of 7.8%, while the World Bank revises its growth outlook to 7.1%. Yet, Dalal Street faces turbulence as benchmark indices suffer losses exceeding 1%. This is largely due to foreign investors offloading shares and rising bond yields globally, fostering a cautious sentiment in the market.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi’s presence puts Sanju Samson under pressure
item.description: Ishan Kishan is returning to his hometown of Ranchi, ready to take on the West Indies in the second T20I. This match offers a golden opportunity for Kishan to demonstrate his skill and confidence. The batting coach of India highlighted their unwavering fearless attitude towards the game. With selection decisions on bowlers and batting spots pending, players are eager to impress.
item.dc:creator: SOURAV MODAK

item.title: Woman claims 2.5 acres was ancestral after stepmother sold it; why HC rejected plea
item.description: The Madras High Court held that the property was not ancestral but self-acquired. As a result, under Hindu law, the man and his mother were legally entitled to execute the gift settlement deed in favour of the man’s second wife, who could subsequently sell the property.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: US plans to livestream Fort Hood shooter’s death; first public execution in 90 years
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: Non-cyclist CEO rides 2,000 miles in 12 days, raises $766K for 70 causes
item.description: Matt King, CEO of Gobundance, trained for five and a half months before cycling nearly 2,000 miles from Mexico to Canada in 12 days. Along the journey, King and his team raised more than $766,000 and distributed funds to over 70 individuals and organisations, supporting families and communities facing financial hardships.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Swift, Kelce called 'absentee' owners over $5.35M Ohio mansion plan
item.description: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are facing objections from neighbours over security fencing and landscaping at their $5.35 million Ohio mansion. Residents have raised concerns about a shared sewer line, wildlife safety and privacy. The couple’s representatives say they scaled back the fence and preserved neighbour access, while the board requested revisions to shoreline tree plans.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Jaipur couple started with rented cows; now runs Rs 2.4 crore sustainable farm
item.description: Founded in 2018 by Vibhor Jain and Ishita Jain, Kinaya Organic Farms began with a handful of Gir cows. Fast forward to today, they operate a flourishing farm with 100 cows, branching into a variety of dairy products and agroforestry practices. Their sustainable approach incorporates cow dung biogas, rainwater management, and solar energy, ensuring a self-sufficient model that yields impressive annual profits while promoting environmental stewardship.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: iPhone burst in pocket, injured thumb; court orders Apple to replace it, pay Rs 36,139
item.description: A district consumer commission in Uttar Pradesh found Apple India liable for a defective iPhone incident. The phone burst in a consumer’s pocket, injuring his thumb and damaging his personal photos. Following medical treatment, the commission ordered compensation for the consumer’s treatment expenses and directed a refund or replacement. Apple and the local seller failed to dispute the claims presented during the hearings.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH THAKUR

item.title: Flydubai cockpit attack: Israel to honour Capt Smit with top civilian bravery award
item.description: Israel has announced that Captain Smit Machchhar will receive a prestigious Presidential Award for his bravery. He prevented a potential aviation disaster aboard Flydubai flight FZ1073 by acting decisively against a radicalized co-pilot. During the incident, six Israeli passengers displayed great courage in assisting Machchhar and foiling the hijack attempt. This heroic act has led to a broader investigation into the circumstances of the attack.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.dc:creator: AADRITA HALDER

item.description: Stock market recommendations: Axis Bank, and Authum Investment & Infrastructure Ltd have been recommended as the top stocks to buy today on October 9, 2026 by Hitesh Rathi, Technical Analyst (Equity & Derivatives) at Angel One.
item.dc:creator: SMRITI JAIN

item.title: 'ICE out of our neighbourhoods’: Shooting of man sparks protests in New York
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: Abhishek Sharma on the cusp of breaking Suryakumar Yadav’s unique T20I record
item.description: Abhishek Sharma is on the brink of achieving a remarkable milestone, needing just 53 runs to cross 2,000 T20I runs during the second T20I against West Indies. With a chance to eclipse Suryakumar Yadav's record for the fastest attainment of this feat, Sharma's current high strike rate demonstrates his game-changing prowess.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY

item.title: Nana Patekar cremated with full state honours, fans bid tearful farewell
item.description: The Indian film industry mourns the loss of Nana Patekar, who succumbed to cardiac arrest as confirmed by his son. The actor's passing, attributed to natural causes, prompted the Maharashtra government to orchestrate a state funeral fitting his legacy in cinema. Tributes poured in from fans and fellow actors in Pune, with many sharing their fond memories of the beloved artist on social media.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
